notes.title: v1.1.1 Released!
notes.content:
The "Triple-One" Update is here and brings a new feature, some new content, and a bunch of bug fixes!

[h2]Flares[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/2b1c32b14aef63fb46c870ca35a123fffdb5e655.jpg[/img]
[b]Flares[/b] are a brand new mode of in-game communication.  Select a flare from the UI crosshair button next to the 'Fire' button.  Choose 'Team' or 'All', and then select a placement on the map.
[b]Circle[/b]- Specify crates, tanks, or anything on the map.
[b]Arrow[/b]- Signal your movement or request an ally to move.
[b]Crosshair[/b]- Direct your attacks towards a specific enemy.
[b]X[/b]- Specify a bumper hit point, or just about anything you want to.

[h2]Dual-Wheeld Tank Track[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/b052a25f76259c55779bd9c807a1b737cc4a12cb.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Dogtags[/h2]
We added a heap of new possible Dogtags to keep things fresh.

[h2]Bug Fixes & Tweaks[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed negative countdown error when starting matches
[*]Wanderer now works correctly in Rebound and Vortex matches
[*]Fixed the unusual 'Portal Gun' and bumper interaction
[*]Fixed Sonar projectile size discrepancy
[*]Fixed bug where 'Static' weapons hit self in FFA matches
[*]Healing weapons are no longer assigned in Charge & Points modes
[*]Increased Deathmatch XP multiplier from 1.3x to 1.5x
[*]Increased Assassin XP multiplier from 1.45x to 1.6x
[/list]

Thanks for reading and I'll see you in-game!  If you haven't already, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2396760/ShellShot_Arena/]Wishlist ShellShot Arena[/url] to follow development.

-kChamp

notes.title: v1.1.1 & Roadmap
notes.content:
[h2]v1.1.1[/h2]
v1.1.1 is already under development and slotted for [b]May 20th[/b]!  This update will bring a couple notable new features (like flares for better team communication), a handful of new content, and many bug fixes.  Keep an eye out for it!

[h2]Console Updates[/h2]
Once v1.1.1 has dropped on Steam, we're going to switch our focus to bringing the latest version of the game to both Xbox and PlayStation versions.  These versions are currently still on v1.0.  There are a few hoops to jump through to release an update on console platforms, so this step might take some time.

[h2]Nintendo Switch[/h2]
We've been exploring the possibility of bringing the game to Nintendo Switch and think it would be a great fit for the platform.

[h2]ShellShot Arena[/h2]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2396760/ShellShot_Arena/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/f5e34ed0abd07a9cdffc0c69cfe8802524143bf5.jpg[/img][/url]
We recently announced [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2396760/ShellShot_Arena/]ShellShot Arena[/url], a fast-paced, top-down, online multiplayer game from the 'ShellShock Live' universe. Master a massive arsenal of upgradable weapons to be the last tank standing in Team, Free-For-All, and Battle Royale matches.  [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2396760/ShellShot_Arena/]Wishlist it on Steam here.[/url]

notes.title: v1.1 Released!
notes.content:
The v1.1 Update has dropped! Keep reading for the patch notes:

[h1]New Game Mechanic: Healing[/h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/2776a4d768ba83698d513ffc9195ee238936852d.jpg[/img]
Several of the following new weapons have new healing abilities, adding an unexplored layer of strategy to the game. Opting for a clutch ally heal may be more effective than doling out damage, depending on the current landscape.

[h1]24 New Weapons[/h1]
[h2]New Weapon Set: Health Aura[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/ffccd0a927a0ec59afbc54550cc2b650794cf5e8.jpg[/img]
[b]Health Aura[/b] is the most standard of healing weapons. Upon use, it generates a healing aura around your tank, regenerating health for you and any tanks inside the aura. The healing aura is [b]extra effective[/b] on allies, healing them for greater HP amounts. Be careful- enemies inside the aura heal too! Upgrade the weapon for a larger radius and more powerful effects.
[h3]Tier 1: Health Aura[/h3]
[h3]Tier 2: Health Aura+[/h3]
[h3]Tier 3: Health Aura++[/h3]
[b]Unlock Criteria: Unlocked by default[/b]

[h2]New Weapon Set: Confuser[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/f3bd35a16e0b6027efbf2422540a0ca56470ba23.jpg[/img]
[b]Confuser[/b] plays tricks on enemy tanks causing them to shoot themselves. Protect your electronics- you don't want to be on the receiving end of this one.
[h3]Tier 1: Confuser[/h3]
[h3]Tier 2: Super-Confuser[/h3]
[h3]Tier 3: Mega-Confuser[/h3]
[b]Unlock Criteria: Unlocked at Star Level 2[/b]

[h2]New Weapon Set: CensorBar[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/7a5bcf6ac08c20babf1f15bfb2df800022fc0b7c.jpg[/img]
[b]CensorBar[/b] is sort of a mystery to us. We'd tell you what it does if we knew, but unfortunately it's been censored behind a pesky censor bar. All we know is that it packs a punch.
[h3]Tier 1: CensorBar[/h3]
[h3]Tier 2: RestrictedBar[/h3]
[h3]Tier 3: RedactedBar[/h3]
[b]Unlock Criteria: Unlocked in the Gear Shop[/b]

[h2]New Weapon Set: Health Potion[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/fe308210b0cb70eab00555d9efe3044245bfb6e5.jpg[/img]
These [b]Health Potions[/b] are specially formulated to maintain their efficacy even at the high pressures of a tank barrel. They're effective at delivering HP over long distances in projectile fashion.
[h3]Tier 1: Small Potion[/h3]
[h3]Tier 2: Medium Potion[/h3]
[h3]Tier 3: Large Potion[/h3]
[h3]Tier 4: Huge Potion[/h3]
[b]Unlock Criteria: Unlocked by completing challenge: 'Medic'[/b]

[h2]New Weapon Set: Wanderer[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/084539f7f02f350c2beda6bc656a17061de2db12.jpg[/img]
[b]Wanderer[/b] has a mind of its own- all you can do is guide it in the right direction. Land it where you please and then cross your fingers that it finds your target.
[h3]Tier 1: Wanderer[/h3]
[h3]Tier 2: Double Wanderer[/h3]
[h3]Tier 3: Triple Wanderer[/h3]
[b]Unlock Criteria: Unlocked by completing challenge: 'Daily Dominator'[/b]

[h2]New Weapon Set: Kiss[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/b297ab796c6c7c5809b9fd94e25ab0f2a3850c51.jpg[/img]
Plant a [b]Kiss[/b] on your opponents to [b]steal HP[/b] for yourself. It's kinda like reverse CPR.
[h3]Tier 1: Kiss[/h3]
[h3]Tier 2: French Kiss[/h3]
[h3]Tier 3: Smooch[/h3]
[b]Unlock Criteria: Unlocked in the Gear Shop[/b]

[h2]Weapon Set: CropDuster[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/8b2a5ddcbf5d92d7404c3bc5414b178eb341a470.jpg[/img]
Those of you who have beat our game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/412620/CropDuster_Supreme/]CropDuster Supreme[/url] on Steam will know what this weapon is all about. We might have to add tank gas masks to the gear shop for safety.
[h3]Tier 1: CropDuster[/h3]
[h3]Tier 2: NoxiousDuster[/h3]
[h3]Tier 3: ToxicDuster[/h3]
[b]Unlock Criteria: Unlocked in the Gear Shop[/b]

[h2]New Weapon Set: PyroSlam[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/f600d792d6b647b783c7e8f07ad7323492644d8b.jpg[/img]
A tribute to our game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/493460/PyroSlam_VR_Table_Tennis/]PyroSlam[/url] on Steam.  We all know that Table Tennis is the most dangerous of all sports... especially when the ball is on fire. I think this weapon captures that nicely.
[h3]Tier 1: PongSlam[/h3]
[h3]Tier 2: PyroSlam[/h3]
[b]Unlock Criteria: Unlocked in the Gear Shop[/b]

[h1]Dogtags[/h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/3bf15bc4f25044851718693a1a9dc138fe7b382a.jpg[/img]
[b]Dogtags[/b] are collectible visual banners unlocked in a variety of ways. Each displays a unique design and can be equipped behind your name badge to be shown in all areas of the game. This update contains [b]101 Unique Dogtags[/b]- rep your favorite! Rarity ranges from [i]Common[/i] to [i]Legendary[/i] and is depicted by the [i]Rarity Symbol[/i] on the dogtag.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/a1170f81634bb3ee6485cdb0f6c3d417e93267c7.jpg[/img]

[h1]Cosmetic Points[/h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/3e85e442390a20a066ea4a034a7ffd2dd86507ef.jpg[/img]
Cosmetic Points are a new in-game currency earned by [b]completing Daily Challenges[/b] or purchased in the shop. They are used to unlock [b]cosmetic items only- never anything that can give players an advantage or affect gameplay.[/b] ShellShock Live will never be 'Pay-2-Win', and we worked hard to make sure any optional purchases of cosmetic items can only benefit the community.

[h1]Daily Challenges[/h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/03d0b5f4d54c30d232050f6099371dc9873d2829.jpg[/img]
Each day, you're given 3 bonus challenges to complete. Challenges range from dealing damage and getting kills to landing specific skillshots and earning XP. Complete these challenges to earn [b]Cosmetic Points[/b], which are used to unlock various cosmetic items from the shop.

[h2]Daily Dogtag[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/60efb84a7280edff218486664f3492783c8eb6b7.jpg[/img]
Complete all 3 daily challenges to uncover your [b]Daily Dogtag[/b]. From here, you have a choice of two options:
[olist]
[*][b]Unlock It[/b]- Like what you see? Unlock it from the shop using your previously banked Cosmetic Points.
[*][b]Bank It[/b]- Skip the dogtag and bank a [b]5 Cosmetic Point[/b] reward. Save up for a tag that really catches your eye.
[/olist][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/c760e07899e6f6bc5bb0b45976d72d0cc4f195b0.jpg[/img]

[h1]MiniGames[/h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/adc4eff4a3f9c2f773f0a3a62b33e5086d321182.jpg[/img]
Sick of dying early and waiting for the round to finish? Spin up a minigame on a translucent popup to kill time while spectating. Who knows- maybe you'll even get an achievement out of the deal.

[h2]PongShock[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/710785a6fb652323bde4ccc83ef2a13b119a8463.jpg[/img]
ShellShock Live fans from the Flash days will remember this classic. What it may lack in originality, it makes up for with such a cool name. Use the Up/Down arrow keys to move your paddle. Play to 7 against the computer. Beat Easy to advance to Medium, etc.

[h1]Tank Headlights and Taillights[/h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/4276dea34ded31344ae5ee8bcb952b8863677457.jpg[/img]
We've added two full new sets of tank parts. Light up the terrain before you with one of several styles.

[h1]Game News Popup[/h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/d060569f40e841b8a996da9e7ea87f87d0f41ace.jpg[/img]
The [b]News Popup[/b] on the main menu lets us communicate in-game to all players between updates. This is part of an effort to be more active in the community with better communication about the game and the roadmap looking forward.

[h1]5 New Challenges[/h1]
[h2]New Challenge: Time Killer[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/d6da6450025c558a3623e119adba3df1d0078708.jpg[/img]
Beat the 'PongShock' minigame on Hard mode.
[b]Reward XP: +200xp[/b]
[b]Additional Reward: Unique Dogtag[/b]

[h2]New Challenge: Medic[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/d5d4bc83517127b0989b4b912a8d0b9965f2d611.jpg[/img]
Heal allies 25 times.
[b]Reward XP: +250xp[/b]
[b]Additional Reward: Unique Dogtag[/b]

[h2]New Challenge: Weekday Warrior[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/9b6a78fe1d207841c5666b4171c33f9c540ae738.jpg[/img]
Complete and claim 5 daily challenges.
[b]Reward XP: +50xp[/b]
[b]Additional Reward: Unique Dogtag[/b]

[h2]New Challenge: Daily Dominator[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/4b52083000475063eae7ce26b4ddc5bcca74e4b7.jpg[/img]
Complete and claim 50 daily challenges.
[b]Reward XP: +500xp[/b]
[b]Additional Reward: Unique Dogtag[/b]
[b]Additional Reward: 'Wanderer' Weapon[/b]

[h2]New Challenge: Doggone-It[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/276197342b250ce12d3d5695543ef060db1d4c4c.jpg[/img]
Unlock 5 Daily Dogtags.
[b]Reward XP: +100xp[/b]
[b]Additional Reward: Unique Dogtag[/b]

[h1]New Game Option: Choose your Starting Weapon Count[/h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/a8f3dd49f0946008cb6b0a57d856320364f7a5b4.jpg[/img]
Looking to level-up a specific weapon or need one to complete a challenge? Crank up the starting weapon count for better selection. Want to limit weapons in the match for a unique twist? Go right ahead! Increasing Starting Weapon count slightly reduces XP multiplier for obvious reasons.

[h1]New Game Mod: Cage Match[/h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/27c8327dd6a405286630c5f4b6a4559a77083227.jpg[/img]
[b]Cage Match[/b] raises the side bumpers by 300%, leading to some truly chaotic gameplay.

[h1]Progress Screen Upgrade[/h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/58ad8d5d26c0448bbb7be6de6325d1e6f6626e5d.jpg[/img]
The [b]Hub Progress Screen[/b] has been updated to include all unlockables in the game. Progress bar categories now include:
[list]
[*]Weapons
[*]Tank Upgrades
[*]Tank Parts
[*]Maps
[*]Themes
[*]Challenges
[*]Missions
[*]Victory Tunes
[*]Dogtags
[/list]

[h1]Wind in the Firing Range[/h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/269e083a6e4629d0e980a28458f5d30a40a0c742.jpg[/img]
You asked for it, and we delivered. Practice your aim in all scenarios for optimal play. Firing Range Wind Options:
[list]
[*]None
[*]Low
[*]Medium
[*]High
[/list]
[h1]Wind on Game Listing[/h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/fb21f177c8481d1db96d8579ea38590deb2d34e5.jpg[/img]
Games that have wind enabled now display a wind icon in the server list.

[h1]Numbered Portals[/h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/42d5bd7e5ee8c403cfe3d1f72f1e13bc25593608.jpg[/img]
Multiple sets of portals on the screen? They're now numbered to help distinguish pairs.

[h1]Resolution Settings[/h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/edb4cc33b0879cc63343b6a76d48284d3daa1fe5.jpg[/img]
[b]Resolution and Fullscreen Options[/b] are now found in the in-game settings instead of in a pre-game launcher. This is cleaner, and it helps us achieve full controller support and possible future Steam Deck support.

[h1]Sprite Quality[/h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/c509e48583ba2e6cfdb53bc6304ec67f001d4537.jpg[/img]
We've sharpened textures and sprites used throughout the game for better visual quality. You'll notice this most on small sprites like Weapon or Item Icons.

[h1]Two New Audio Tracks[/h1]
The ShellShock Live soundtrack gets two epic new songs.  

[h1]Performance Improvements[/h1]
Updated the Unity Engine a couple generations for better performance, efficiency, and stability. ShellShock Live now runs as a 64-bit executable for further performance and memory improvements.

[h1]And More...[/h1]
We can't fit everything we added to v1.1 in this post, but here are a few more notes:
[list]
[*]New [b]Ranked[/b] Game Option that can now be disabled to stop matches from affecting your Elo Skill Rating
[*]Skill Ratings no longer reset after reaching too high of a level
[*]Fortify no longer stalls your turn in all-shot mode
[*]Fortify & Overcharge are no longer found in crates
[*][b]Main Menu Chat[/b] in the Settings disables the global chat on the main menu
[*]The Unlock Screen is now displayed whenever you unlock a weapon- including from the shop
[*]Gamepads no longer rumble when the 'Gamepad' setting is turned off in Settings
[*]Fixed issue where players couldn't join games with negative gears
[/list]

*EDIT* The CropDuster and PyroSlam weapons were originally intended to be bonuses for owners of the respective games on Steam, this didn't fit in line with keeping all weapons earnable in-game.  These weapons are now available in the Gear Shop. :)

Thank you for your continued support. As always, please report any bugs you find, and I'll see you in-game!

notes.title: ShellShock Live Mobile Beta & v1.1 Dev Update
notes.content:
[h1]Mobile Beta[/h1]

*EDIT* Thank you to all who participated in the mobile beta (4/7 - 4/15)!  We were able to squash some bugs and add some useful features and tweaks.  More importantly, it was a great test run for the upcoming mobile launch on [b]May 12th[/b]!  The game won't be playable until then, but feel free to Pre-Register on Android or Pre-Order on iOS by searching 'ShellShock Live' on the respective app store.

[h1]v1.1 Dev Update[/h1]

Thanks for your suggestions in the last post!  Most of our effort is going towards getting the mobile app running smoothly, but once that's done all our dev firepower will be pointed towards v1.1.  Here's a sneak peek at what we have in the works right now:
[list]
[*]Daily Challenges for gears, xp, and rewards
[*]More in-depth cosmetic customizations
[*]Plenty of new weapons
[*]Bug fixes and balance tweaks
[/list]
There are a few more planned items I want to list here but won't yet because I'm not 100% sure they'll make it.  Stay tuned for a more detailed feature list as we get further with v1.1 development.

Thanks for reading and I'll see you on the battlefield!

-kChamp

notes.title: v1.0 Released!
notes.content:
After several years and [b][i]164 Updates[/i][/b] (yes, we counted) we've officially reached [b]Version 1.0[/b].  Keep reading for the update notes... it's a big one!

[h2]Attack Drones[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/581cf3377463bd4dd1723fd155665f4d8ca957d2.png[/img]
Attack drones will occasionally scatter throughout the sky, prepared for battle.  Hit one with a shot and it'll join forces with your team and [b]attack your enemies[/b]!  Drones last one turn and fly away when they've completed their assault.


[h2]Firing Range Scenario Editor[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/30ccc6361cfa918109756cd616f2f08e69e71e3e.png[/img]
A fully featured [b]Scenario Editor[/b] has been added to the [b]Firing Range[/b].  [b]Modify the map[/b], [b]add obstacles and enemies[/b], and then [b]test your creation[/b]!  Useful for practicing unique setups, testing the limits of weapons, or just messing around! Enter the Scenario Editor by pressing the "Edit" button in the top left corner of the Firing Range.


[h2]Ally Aim Visibility[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/f6f0d67624ed71ab6c95ed5e9cd4f22ae11d396a.png[/img]
Teammate aim details are now [b]fully visible[/b], unlocking an entirely [b]new level of strategy[/b]!  Plan out your shots based on your environment and teammate's decisions.  Pair it with teammate weapon visibility for the [b]ultimate tactical advantage[/b].  Teammate aim details are even visible after your tank has been destroyed.


[h2]X3 Damage Buff[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/25a74a35db3c99567f327ed9aa63f493a93d4f20.png[/img]
[b]Supercharge your projectile[/b] with this rare multiplier causing [b]3 times the damage[/b].  Make sure to grab it before your opponents do-  the extra damage is valuable!  [b]X3[/b] buffs are considerably smaller and more difficult to hit than [b]X2[/b]s.


[h2]Mission Thumbnails[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/905f00e0e9ae9cba17ecea47fb59c0df063b5004.png[/img]
The mission set list got a [b]visual overhaul[/b] and now displays a [b]previews of the mission[/b].  Tank positions, bumpers, buffs, and portals included.


[h2]Vortex Mode[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/8bd3185f331bc6d253282233a73ca0d8f44a28d5.png[/img]
In Vortex Mode, all shots must first [b]pass through a portal[/b] before dealing damage to an enemy.  It's similar to rebound, but with an inter-dimensional twist.  Portals are continually rotating out, so you'll have to discover and remember which portals match up!


[h2]Star Badges[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/a1eb64569059a62cc8393b74fb2011ba8c101734.png[/img]

We've added a new campaign bonus set with [b]10 tough new missions[/b] leveraging [b]updated game mechanics[/b].  New missions range from flushing out protected enemies with 22 attack drones to hunting down foes with nothing but a dagger.  Complete the entire set for a reward.  Good luck!


[h2]New Items: Overcharge & Fortify[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/fdac829b39aa80075bbb808e19b5f2d0e103529c.png[/img]
Two new items, [b]Overcharge[/b], and [b]Fortify[/b], open up unexplored [b]tactical avenues[/b].  Unlimited uses add an element [b]risk and reward[/b].


[h3]Overcharge[/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/4eee0149809d2652086e6bbf7d0851ce9ec11e64.png[/img]
Instead of firing your weapon, use [b]Overcharge[/b] to [b]boost the damage[/b] of your [i]next[/i] shot.  Overcharge can be used an [b]unlimited number of times[/b], but the effects will not be stacked.  Overcharge is useful if you don't currently have a great shot, or want to make that Sniper in your arsenal [i]really[/i] count next turn.
[b]Overcharge Damage Boost: 25% [/b]

[h3]Fortify[/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/92dd518803d9a474f91810babeb96c2067cc25ac.png[/img]
Use [b]Fortify[/b] to [b]hunker down[/b] and [b]take less damage next turn[/b].  Similar to Overcharge, it takes the place of firing your weapon.  Fortify can also be used an [b]unlimited number of times[/b], but the effects will not be stacked.  Balance the utility of [b]increased defense[/b] with [b]Fortify[/b], or [b]increased damage[/b] with [b]Overcharge[/b] to decide which to use.
[b]Fortify Damage Reduction: 25% [/b]


[h2]Items in the Gear Shop[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/9b29dd039c26bd7c3d695d55077529b9da0283d8.png[/img]
We've received many requests to allow the [b]purchase of items with gears[/b] in the Gear Shop, and it's finally a possibility!  Stock up on supplies with your spare gears.  Keep in mind, shield effects have changed (more details later in the post.)


[h2]Challenge: Autonomous Combat[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/5f2bf2835279eefde2e8b6cb1ec646e065792ee7.png[/img]
Destroy 5 tanks with an attack drone.
[b]Reward: Drone Weapon + 500xp[/b]


[h2]Weapon: Drone[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/e3a1743872bd877e0d3929cdd18a4bb638a834f0.png[/img]
Fire an [b]autonomous attack drone[/b] into the play arena.  The drone will lock on to an enemy and fire at the target.
[b]Weapon Level 1: Drone[/b]
[b]Weapon Level 2: Heavy Drone[/b]
[b]Unlock Criteria: Complete "Autonomous Combat" Challenge[/b]


[h2]Weapon: Permaroller[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/eb3febfa95b76e8cd2e686bd5ca1f29deb8a92cb.png[/img]
Similar to a standard Roller, but with a significant difference: The [b]Permaroller[/b] won't automatically explode on enemy contact.  This means you'll have to land the projectile a good distance in front of your target for a [b]perfectly timed explosion[/b].  With the added difficulty comes [b]increased damage[/b]- Permaroller packs a punch.
[b]Tier 1: Permaroller[/b]
[b]Tier 2: Heavy Permaroller[/b]
[b]Unlock Criteria: Purchase Permaroller in the Gear Shop[/b]


[h2]Weapon Tiers: Paprika and Cayenne[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/567e61dac12f8de5d368d54cb4f062d0adf9763e.png[/img]
The [not so] beloved Salt and Pepper weapon gets a couple spicy new additions.
Tier 1: Pepper
Tier 2: Salt and Pepper
[b]Tier 3: Paprika[/b]
[b]Tier 4: Cayenne[/b]


[h2]Weapon Tier: Construction[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/219d7125ce1d74c32e70736ad48596c605b28965.png[/img]
By popular demand, Builder now joins it's big brother, Digger, with a [b]third tier[/b].  Similar to Excavation, Construction fires plenty of projectiles working together to [b]construct a mountain of terrain[/b].
Tier 1: Builder
Tier 2: MegaBuilder
[b]Tier 3: Construction[/b]


[h2]Player Tag Visual Upgrade[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/65f062fffa33314988c80fa2ab061e7b59165e09.png[/img]
Player names have received a subtle [b]visual upgrade[/b].  The color gradient indicates whether the player is an ally or enemy.


[h2]Item Tooltip[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/336493a8251557371bbccc5747d45109ebf72cf5.png[/img]
Hovering over an item with your mouse now displays a concise [b]item tooltip[/b] describing the item's effects.  Mostly helpful for beginning players learning the game, but also useful to remind players the effects of the two new items, Overcharge and Fortify.


[h2]Obstacles Game Option[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/3cf733adb137f890720dbd557e9db12de2a45c79.png[/img]

[b]Critical Hits[/b] look much more pleasing now, and are marked by a [b]distinct new sound effect[/b].  Doing major damage has never felt sweeter.


[h2]Obstacle Adjustments[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/c9a0982dff125d5073ae88def8a293dca90894c0.png[/img]
Obstacles like Bumpers, Portals, Black Holes, and Attack Drones now have a chance to [b]span multiple turns[/b].  This means if you don't grab that "x2" buff, your opponent just might!


[h2]Laser Sight Gun[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/5bee61c8277b7b85390a7a033aba4c65a50f9989.png[/img]
Trick out and soup up your gun with a stylish [b]Laser Sight[/b] upgrade.
[b]Unlock Criteria: Three Star Badge (★★★)[/b]


[h2]Shielded Track[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/1e83c0a312fff2b4fe3d0414d15454336b0cd6f4.png[/img]
Always protect your tank's valuable treads and inner workings.  It's easy with the [b]Shielded Track[/b].
[b]Unlock Criteria: Purchase Shielded Track in the Gear Shop[/b]


[h2]Pidgeonholes Map[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/969b3d5fa651feaaa4c6b1ce0dec3abc8381da4d.png[/img]
Each tank get's it's own protected bunker.  Watch out for grenades!
[b]Unlock Criteria: Complete the Bonus Missions[/b]

    [*]Banana
    [*]Battering Ram
    [*]Dead Riser
    [*]Drill Bits
    [*]Driller

[h2]Audio Enhancements[/h2][b]Two brand new tracks[/b] have been added to the score, bringing the game to [b]10 unique pieces[/b].  Explosion sounds have been revamped with [b]more variety[/b] and [b]more powerful[/b] sounding blasts.  There's a new confirmation sound when you [b]lock in[/b] your shot.  Several other small additions.


[h2]Many More Improvements[/h2]The list goes on and on, but here are some notable ones:[list][*]No more Attractoids in Rebound Mode :)
    [*]The scroll wheel now works in the server list, the campaign mission list as well as a few hub screens that didn't work before
   [*]Movement is now preemptively streamed, causing much less latency.  No more watching enemies move at the last second past the move timer.
   [*]The [b]Level Field Mod[/b] now has an XP multiplier of 0.9x (previously 0.5x)
   [*]Fixed a bug where buffs in missions would be of a random size
   [*]Adjusted Weapon XP required to upgrade the 'Counter' weapon family
   [*]Fixed visual glitch when the XP Indicator spawns
   [*]Player Levels are now visible in Tournaments
   [*]Fixed bug where the Tank upgrade bar would go past the edge on the Tank Upgrade screen
   [*]Fixed Shoccer glitch, where some weapons would affect the score improperly
   [*]Item buttons now grey-out when you have 0
   [*]Mac OSX Catalina users will no longer receive a warning regarding 64-bit support
   [*]Optimized textures for better performance and fidelity
   [*]Upgraded Unity engine to latest stable version for stability and performance improvements
   [*]Fixed bug where crates would contain points in modes that didn't support points
   [*]Fixed bug where the gamepad D-Pad would affect your aim while choosing a weapon
   [*]Fixed bug where a player could use an item without any effect when in 'Shoot-Only' mode
   [*]The Shadow weapon is now correctly invisible (except for the shadow)
   [*]Several missions have been balanced (Looking at you, Fiesta Forever)
   [*]Several weapons have been adjusted (including Botherer, Breaker Mania, and Acid Rain)
   [*]Fixed bug where Solar Flare could bounce endlessly between side-bumpers
   [*]Some explosions and effects received a visual upgrade/tuning
[/list]

[h3]Thanks[/h3]I want to thank all of you so much for supporting ShellShock Live for so long, some of you even from the Flash days.  It's a dream come true to be able to work on a game I love for a living, and I'm both excited and proud to have reached Version 1.0.  I watched the old Steam Greenlight trailer for SSL recently, and it's almost comical how far things have come. Contrast that to the New v1.0 Trailer released today- crazy.
[previewyoutube=tZytNrNvQhU;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Does this mean the end of updates?[/h3]No way!  There's [b]much[/b] more in store. :)

-kChamp

notes.title: v0.9.8.10 Mini-Update Released!
notes.content:
Some players have been complaining of connection issues with ShellShock Live for a long time.  Today's mini-update adds a new system that intelligently tries to reconnect users disconnected by an 'EndRead' or 'ReceivedBytes == 0' error.  If reconnected successfully, you should never notice you were disconnected in the first place.  Previously, you would have been kicked out of the game (and match) and forced to reconnect from scratch.  This feature is early in development, so it might not always work, but it's a start.

For those of you affected by connection issues, please let me know if this update helps improve the situation.

Thanks!

-Kyle
